subject: Web Development
title: Augmented Reality on the Web
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Augmented Reality on the Web.

hook.text: WebXR lets you overlay digital content onto the real world through a phone or headset camera.

buildup.text: Furniture stores let you place a virtual couch in your living room before buying.

discovery.text: No app download needed. The experience runs entirely in the browser.

twist.text: AR on the web is still limited by device capabilities and browser support.

climax.text: As headsets improve, web-based AR could become as common as watching a video today.

punchline.text: The web will blend with the physical world.

quiz.question: What does WebXR enable?
options: Augmented and virtual reality in browsers
